item.title: ‘Tangled’: Kathryn Hahn To Play Villain Mother Gothel In Disney’s Live-Action Film, Teagan Croft & Milo Manheim Also Cast
item.description: Disney is giving “Tangled” fans what they want. After months of online pleas from fans for Kathryn Hahn to get cast as Mother Grothel in the upcoming live-action remake of the 2010 animated film, THR reports that the studio is in final talks with the actress to play the villain. The news comes on the heels of THR also reporting that Disney has their Rapunzel and Flynn Rider, too; Teagan Croft will be the former, Milo Manheim the latter. item.title: ‘Industry’: Myha’la On New Alliances, Old Wounds & A Reinvented Harper [Season 4 Interview]
item.description: In the HBO drama “Industry,” co-creators and writers Mickey Down and Konrad Kay—both veterans of the dizzyingly fast-paced finance world they’re dramatizing—track a ruthless ecosystem where young bankers and power players scramble for leverage inside London’s investment scene. What starts as a portrait of grind and aspiration quickly becomes something sharper: a series about how money distorts relationships, how loyalty becomes transactional, and how ambition turns into a kind of daily survival.

item.title: Tessa Thompson Won’t Confirm A ‘Doomsday’ Appearance, But Wants To Keep Exploring Valkyrie & The ‘Creed’ Franchise
item.description: Franchises—and the fandom that feeds them—crave certainty: the hard yes, the full-stop no, the cameo “confirmed” by a passport stamp or the U.K. rumor mill.
